onboarding.willkommen.text: Gregor sends you a briefing every morning and evening for your trips and location comparisons and reports alerts when the weather changes. You can create a trip or a location comparison and send a test email to your verified address beforehand.
onboarding.checkliste.trip_oder_vergleic: At least one trip or location comparison created
onboarding.hinweis.sms: Your plan includes SMS as a channel.
onboarding.hinweis.premium_sms: Your plan includes Premium SMS (Garmin inReach) as a channel.
onboarding.testmail.fehler: The test email could not be sent.
